sourceBehavior.summary: Launch-era unlock is community-reported but not bound to a complete AYIA identity capture. AYKE-to-AYIA rollback is unverified, so the normal AYKE flow stops at rollback-unverified. A separate disabled, simulation-only, unqualified plan records the complete hypothetical order and synthetic edge cases without authorizing hardware behavior.

muraPolicy.writeBoundary: The normal AYKE runtime flow ends at rollback-unverified before package inspection or writes. The complete rollback-plus-unlock order and package/write edge cases are separate disabled simulation-only unqualified flows. They require fixture-marked typed evidence, authorize no live adapter, and make no hardware-success claim.

digest.reason: No vendor-authenticated or independently reproduced SHA-256 digest is available. Inspection cannot produce a verified output until an expected digest and exact member filenames are independently established.
